title: CueFX orb preview (one entry per plate frame)
description: Made by the render's own code (cuefx.route.orb_path and entrance_gain). x, y, diameter: what the layout draws, plate px, 3 decimals. visibility: Merge's opacity 0..1 (fade-in, vanish). Outside the effect window nothing is drawn: diameter 0, visibility 0, x and y copied from the nearest window frame.

diameter.description: drawn diameter: the path's diameter x the entrance gain

held.description: optional (v2.3; POST /api/preview always sends it): the corrected track plus anchor_offset at this frame (cuefx.route.held_xy), plate px, 3 decimals; where the hand marker goes. Every frame, also outside the effect window and after the release.
